verses.en: And the whole earth was of one language, and of one speech.
verses.pt: Era, então, toda a terra de uma língua e umas mesmas palavras.
verses.en_web: The whole earth was of one language and of one speech.
verses.en_bbe: And all the earth had one language and one tongue.

verses.en: And it came to pass, as they journeyed from the east, that they found a plain in the land of Shinar; and they dwelt there.
verses.pt: E aconteceu que, quando se partiram do oriente, acharam um vale na terra de Sinear; e ali passaram a habitar.
verses.en_web: As they traveled from the east, they found a plain in the land of Shinar, and they lived there.
verses.en_bbe: And it came about that in their wandering from the east, they came to a stretch of flat country in the land of Shinar, and there they made their living-place.

verses.en: And they said one to another, Go to, let us make brick, and burn them throughly. And they had brick for stone, and slime had they for morter.
verses.pt: E disseram uns aos outros: Vinde, façamos tijolos e o cozamos com fogo. E foi-lhes os tijolos em lugar de pedra, e o betume em lugar de argamassa.
verses.en_web: They said to one another, “Come, let’s make bricks, and burn them thoroughly.” They had brick for stone, and they used tar for mortar.
verses.en_bbe: And they said one to another, Come, let us make bricks, burning them well. And they had bricks for stone, putting them together with sticky earth.

verses.en: And they said, Go to, let us build us a city and a tower, whose top may reach unto heaven; and let us make us a name, lest we be scattered abroad upon the face of the whole earth.
verses.pt: E disseram: Vamos, edifiquemo-nos uma cidade e uma torre, cuja ponta chegue ao céu; e façamo-nos um nome, para que não sejamos espalhados sobre a face de toda a terra.
verses.en_web: They said, “Come, let’s build ourselves a city, and a tower whose top reaches to the sky, and let’s make a name for ourselves, lest we be scattered abroad on the surface of the whole earth.”
verses.en_bbe: And they said, Come, let us make a town, and a tower whose top will go up as high as heaven; and let us make a great name for ourselves, so that we may not be wanderers over the face of the earth.

verses.en: And the LORD came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men builded.
verses.pt: E desceu o SENHOR para ver a cidade e a torre que edificavam os filhos dos homens.
verses.en_web: Yahweh came down to see the city and the tower, which the children of men built.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord came down to see the town and the tower which the children of men were building.

verses.en: And the LORD said, Behold, the people is one, and they have all one language; and this they begin to do: and now nothing will be restrained from them, which they have imagined to do.
verses.pt: E disse o SENHOR: Eis que o povo é um, e todos estes têm uma língua; e começaram a agir, e nada lhes restringirá agora do que pensaram fazer.
verses.en_web: Yahweh said, “Behold, they are one people, and they have all one language, and this is what they begin to do. Now nothing will be withheld from them, which they intend to do.
verses.en_bbe: And the Lord said, See, they are all one people and have all one language; and this is only the start of what they may do: and now it will not be possible to keep them from any purpose of theirs.

verses.en: Go to, let us go down, and there confound their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.
verses.pt: Agora, pois, desçamos, e confundamos ali suas línguas, para que ninguém entenda a fala de seu companheiro.
verses.en_web: Come, let’s go down, and there confuse their language, that they may not understand one another’s speech.”
verses.en_bbe: Come, let us go down and take away the sense of their language, so that they will not be able to make themselves clear to one another.

verses.en: So the LORD scattered them abroad from thence upon the face of all the earth: and they left off to build the city.
verses.pt: Assim os espalhou o SENHOR desde ali sobre a face de toda a terra, e deixaram de edificar a cidade.
verses.en_web: So Yahweh scattered them abroad from there on the surface of all the earth. They stopped building the city.
verses.en_bbe: So the Lord God sent them away into every part of the earth: and they gave up building their town.

verses.en: Therefore is the name of it called Babel; because the LORD did there confound the language of all the earth: and from thence did the LORD scatter them abroad upon the face of all the earth.
verses.pt: Por isto foi chamado o nome dela Babel, porque ali confundiu o SENHOR a língua de toda a terra, e desde ali os espalhou sobre a face de toda a terra.
verses.en_web: Therefore its name was called Babel, because there Yahweh confused the language of all the earth. From there, Yahweh scattered them abroad on the surface of all the earth.
verses.en_bbe: So it was named Babel, because there the Lord took away the sense of all languages and from there the Lord sent them away over all the face of the earth.

verses.en: These are the generations of Shem: Shem was an hundred years old, and begat Arphaxad two years after the flood:
verses.pt: Estas são as gerações de Sem: Sem, de idade de cem anos, gerou a Arfaxade, dois anos depois do dilúvio.
verses.en_web: This is the history of the generations of Shem: Shem was one hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad two years after the flood.
verses.en_bbe: These are the generations of Shem. Shem was a hundred years old when he became the father of Arpachshad, two years after the great flow of waters;

verses.en: And Shem lived after he begat Arphaxad five hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.pt: E viveu Sem, depois que gerou a Arfaxade quinhentos anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.en_web: Shem lived five hundred years after he became the father of Arpachshad, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.en_bbe: And after the birth of Arpachshad, Shem went on living for five hundred years, and had sons and daughters:

verses.en: And Arphaxad lived five and thirty years, and begat Salah:
verses.pt: E Arfaxade viveu trinta e cinco anos, e gerou a Salá.
verses.en_web: Arpachshad lived thirty-five years and became the father of Shelah.
verses.en_bbe: And Arpachshad was thirty-five years old when he became the father of Shelah:

verses.en: And Arphaxad lived after he begat Salah four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.pt: E viveu Arfaxade, depois que gerou a Salá, quatrocentos e três anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.en_web: Arpachshad lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Shelah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.en_bbe: And after the birth of Shelah, Arpachshad went on living for four hundred and three years, and had sons and daughters:

verses.en: And Salah lived thirty years, and begat Eber:
verses.pt: E viveu Salá trinta anos, e gerou a Héber.
verses.en_web: Shelah lived thirty years, and became the father of Eber.
verses.en_bbe: And Shelah was thirty years old when he became the father of Eber:

verses.en: And Salah lived after he begat Eber four hundred and three years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.pt: E viveu Salá, depois que gerou a Héber, quatrocentos e três anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.en_web: Shelah lived four hundred three years after he became the father of Eber, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.en_bbe: And after the birth of Eber, Shelah went on living for four hundred and three years, and had sons and daughters:

verses.en: And Eber lived four and thirty years, and begat Peleg:
verses.pt: E viveu Héber trinta e quatro anos, e gerou a Pelegue.
verses.en_web: Eber lived thirty-four years, and became the father of Peleg.
verses.en_bbe: And Eber was thirty-four years old when he became the father of Peleg:

verses.en: And Eber lived after he begat Peleg four hundred and thirty years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.pt: E viveu Héber, depois que gerou a Pelegue, quatrocentos e trinta anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.en_web: Eber lived four hundred thirty years after he became the father of Peleg, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.en_bbe: And after the birth of Peleg, Eber went on living for four hundred and thirty years, and had sons and daughters:

verses.en: And Peleg lived thirty years, and begat Reu:
verses.pt: E viveu Pelegue, trinta anos, e gerou a Reú.
verses.en_web: Peleg lived thirty years, and became the father of Reu.
verses.en_bbe: And Peleg was thirty years old when he became the father of Reu:

verses.en: And Peleg lived after he begat Reu two hundred and nine years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.pt: E viveu Pelegue, depois que gerou a Reú, duzentos e nove anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.en_web: Peleg lived two hundred nine years after he became the father of Reu, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.en_bbe: And after the birth of Reu, Peleg went on living for two hundred and nine years, and had sons and daughters:

verses.en: And Reu lived two and thirty years, and begat Serug:
verses.pt: E Reú viveu trinta e dois anos, e gerou a Serugue.
verses.en_web: Reu lived thirty-two years, and became the father of Serug.
verses.en_bbe: And Reu was thirty-two years old when he became the father of Serug:

verses.en: And Reu lived after he begat Serug two hundred and seven years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.pt: E viveu Reú, depois que gerou a Serugue, duzentos e sete anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.en_web: Reu lived two hundred seven years after he became the father of Serug, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.en_bbe: And after the birth of Serug, Reu went on living for two hundred and seven years, and had sons and daughters:

verses.en: And Serug lived thirty years, and begat Nahor:
verses.pt: E viveu Serugue trinta anos, e gerou a Naor.
verses.en_web: Serug lived thirty years, and became the father of Nahor.
verses.en_bbe: And Serug was thirty years old when he became the father of Nahor:

verses.en: And Serug lived after he begat Nahor two hundred years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.pt: E viveu Serugue, depois que gerou a Naor, duzentos anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.en_web: Serug lived two hundred years after he became the father of Nahor, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.en_bbe: And after the birth of Nahor, Serug went on living for two hundred years, and had sons and daughters:

verses.en: And Nahor lived nine and twenty years, and begat Terah:
verses.pt: E viveu Naor vinte e nove anos, e gerou a Terá.
verses.en_web: Nahor lived twenty-nine years, and became the father of Terah.
verses.en_bbe: And Nahor was twenty-nine years old when he became the father of Terah:

verses.en: And Nahor lived after he begat Terah an hundred and nineteen years, and begat sons and daughters.
verses.pt: E viveu Naor, depois que gerou a Terá, cento e dezenove anos, e gerou filhos e filhas.
verses.en_web: Nahor lived one hundred nineteen years after he became the father of Terah, and became the father of more sons and daughters.
verses.en_bbe: And after the birth of Terah, Nahor went on living for a hundred and nineteen years, and had sons and daughters:

verses.en: And Terah lived seventy years, and begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.pt: E viveu Terá setenta anos, e gerou a Abrão, e a Naor, e a Harã.
verses.en_web: Terah lived seventy years, and became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.
verses.en_bbe: And Terah was seventy years old when he became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran.

verses.en: Now these are the generations of Terah: Terah begat Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran begat Lot.
verses.pt: Estas são as gerações de Terá: Terá gerou a Abrão, e a Naor, e a Harã; e Harã gerou a Ló.
verses.en_web: Now this is the history of the generations of Terah. Terah became the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran. Haran became the father of Lot.
verses.en_bbe: These are the generations of Terah: Terah was the father of Abram, Nahor, and Haran; and Haran was the father of Lot.

verses.en: And Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his nativity, in Ur of the Chaldees.
verses.pt: E morreu Harã antes que seu pai Terá na terra de seu nascimento, em Ur dos caldeus.
verses.en_web: Haran died before his father Terah in the land of his birth, in Ur of the Chaldees.
verses.en_bbe: And death came to Haran when he was with his father Terah in the land of his birth, Ur of the Chaldees.

verses.en: And Abram and Nahor took them wives: the name of Abram’s wife was Sarai; and the name of Nahor’s wife, Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah, and the father of Iscah.
verses.pt: E tomaram Abrão e Naor para si mulheres: o nome da mulher de Abrão foi Sarai, e o nome da mulher de Naor, Milca, filha de Harã, pai de Milca e de Iscá.
verses.en_web: Abram and Nahor married wives. The name of Abram’s wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor’s wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran who was also the father of Iscah.
verses.en_bbe: And Abram and Nahor took wives for themselves: the name of Abram's wife was Sarai, and the name of Nahor's wife was Milcah, the daughter of Haran, the father of Milcah and Iscah.

verses.en: But Sarai was barren; she had no child.
verses.pt: Mas Sarai era estéril, e não tinha filho.
verses.en_web: Sarai was barren. She had no child.
verses.en_bbe: And Sarai had no child.

verses.en: And Terah took Abram his son, and Lot the son of Haran his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter in law, his son Abram’s wife; and they went forth with them from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan; and they came unto Haran, and dwelt there.
verses.pt: E tomou Terá a Abrão seu filho, e a Ló filho de Harã, filho de seu filho, e a Sarai sua nora, mulher de Abrão seu filho: e saiu com eles de Ur dos caldeus, para ir à terra de Canaã: e vieram até Harã, e assentaram ali.
verses.en_web: Terah took Abram his son, Lot the son of Haran, his son’s son, and Sarai his daughter-in-law, his son Abram’s wife. They went from Ur of the Chaldees, to go into the land of Canaan. They came to Haran and lived there.
verses.en_bbe: And Terah took Abram, his son, and Lot, the son of Haran, and Sarai, his daughter-in-law, the wife of his son Abram and they went out from Ur of the Chaldees, to go to the land of Canaan; and they came to Haran, and were there for some time.

verses.en: And the days of Terah were two hundred and five years: and Terah died in Haran.
verses.pt: E foram os dias de Terá duzentos e cinco anos; e morreu Terá em Harã.
verses.en_web: The days of Terah were two hundred five years. Terah died in Haran.
verses.en_bbe: And all the years of Terah's life were two hundred and five: and Terah came to his end in Haran.
